evidence: The characteristic peaks of zirconium oxide (111), (200), (220) (311) [27-0997 JCPDS file] are visible for the three compositions with lower indium content. The XRD patterns of the 89.90 mol% InO1.5 show cubic In2O3 peaks: (222), (400), (411), (332), (431), (440), (433), (622) and (444) (6-0416 JCPDS file).
